The cause is the host layer's shader loading: the program compiles its Metal sources at startup with newLibraryWithSource, reading the shared shader header and the shaders/ directory relative to the binary's own location, so a binary relocated into out/ (which has no shaders/ directory next to it) cannot initialize Metal at all. The fix I used instead was to keep the binary in pathtracer/ and write its outputs into phase3/out (I had also hit a separate, unrelated failure at #43 when I first tried --out /tmp/base.ppm: "ppm error: cannot open output: /tmp/base.ppm" because /tmp is not writable in this sandbox; that run still printed the round-1 timings render_ms_best=105.947 / gpu_ms_best=105.574).
